ziup5kvtCCR.basis.glb_sideboard.lang_desc: sideboard with a flat screen tv on it. the sideboard is positioned to the right of the tv.

ziup5kvtCCR.basis.glb_mantle.lang_desc: mantle made from reclaimed wood. relative to the fireplace, it is located to the left. on the left of the mantle, there is a mirror. the christmas tree is below the mantle. the clock is on the right side of the mantle. finally, there is a candlestick near the mirror.

ziup5kvtCCR.basis.glb_blanket.lang_desc: blanket that is located next to the sofa, on the left side of the table, and near the plant. it is a white blanket with a tan tassel on one end.
blanket that is situated on top of the bed and is adjacent to the nightstand. the blanket has a blue and white pattern.

ziup5kvtCCR.basis.glb_table.lang_desc: wooden dining table located near the chair, lamp, curtain, plant, bowl of fruit, and blinds.

ziup5kvtCCR.basis.glb_cabinet.lang_desc: cabinet with a lamp on it. the cabinet is located below the lamp.
white cabinet with a white washer and dryer. the cabinet is located towards the top right corner of the frame relative to the washer-dryer.
cabinet with a mirror on it. look for the mirror that is located within the bounds of the cabinet.
cabinet that has a tv mounted on it.

ziup5kvtCCR.basis.glb_washer-dryer.lang_desc: stacked washer-dryer located on top of the cabinet.
the stacked washer-dryer. the stacked washer-dryer is located to the right and below the cabinet.

ziup5kvtCCR.basis.glb_bed.lang_desc: the king size bed located near the mirror and pillow.
queen-sized bed located near a curtain, pillow, and cushion.

ziup5kvtCCR.basis.glb_tv.lang_desc: tv that is mounted on the wall, located to the right of the chest of drawers, below the mirror, and slightly above the picture. use these objects as reference points to identify its position.

ziup5kvtCCR.basis.glb_bathroom cabinet.lang_desc: bathroom cabinet, which is a gray cabinet with a mirror above it. the cabinet is located near the bathroom counter, sink cabinet, and sink. it is positioned to the right of the sink and slightly below the bathroom counter. look for the light fixture above the cabinet for reference.

ziup5kvtCCR.basis.glb_bathtub.lang_desc: bathtub, which is a jacuzzi tub. it is located within the region defined by the "bathtub" bounding box. to find it, locate the "bathtub" platform first, which is within the region defined by the "bathtub platform" bounding box. the bathtub can be found within this platform. additionally, there is a towel located within the region defined by the "towel" bounding box and a plant located within the region defined by the "plant" bounding box. use these objects as references to help locate the bathtub.
